ResearchProjectDef.label: gem cutting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Through careful study and refined technique, your colonists have learned to cut raw gemstones into precise, faceted forms. Cut gems fetch higher prices in trade and can be used in advanced crafting, ceremonial objects, or specialized fabrials on certain shardworlds.

rulesStrings.li: subject->gemcutting
subject_story->spent a decade learning which flaw in a stone is the one that matters
subject_story->cut a gem badly enough that the owner never spoke to them again
subject_story->ground facets by lamplight until the shapes stopped needing to be measured
subject_gerund->cutting gemstones

ResearchProjectDef.label: simple alloys
ResearchProjectDef.description: Combining base metals to create stronger, more useful materials. Unlocks basic alloys like steel and bronze for construction, crafting, and equipment.

rulesStrings.li: subject->alloying
subject_story->learned by ruining enough batches that the ratios stopped being numbers
subject_story->kept a foundry ledger nobody else could read and never got a mix wrong
subject_story->argued with a smith about tin content for eleven years
subject_gerund->mixing metals

ResearchProjectDef.label: complex alloys
ResearchProjectDef.description: Advanced metallurgy techniques enable the forging of rare and potent alloys. Unlocks high-tier materials used in specialized tools, weapons, and metal refinement.

rulesStrings.li: subject->advanced alloying
subject_story->worked out why two metals that should have bonded refused to
subject_story->built a furnace that held a temperature nobody believed it could hold
subject_story->spent a career on the four alloys everyone else called impossible
subject_gerund->working difficult alloys

ResearchProjectDef.label: god metals
ResearchProjectDef.description: Rare and divine, the God Metals transcend ordinary Investiture. This research unlocks the secrets of metals like Atium, Lerasium, and Harmonium—granting powerful abilities, unique crafting recipes, and pivotal roles in ascension, rebirth, and destiny.

rulesStrings.li: subject->the god metals
subject_story->held a bead of something that had been a god and wrote down what it felt like
subject_story->catalogued every account of the god metals and found most of them lying
subject_story->was permitted, once, to examine a sample, and never stopped thinking about it
subject_gerund->studying the god metals

ResearchProjectDef.label: god metal alloys
ResearchProjectDef.description: The fusion of god metals with base metals unlocks powers once thought myth. By alloying lerasium, atium, and other divine substances, it becomes possible to forge new identities, rewrite spiritual DNA, and grant access to the Metallic Arts in ways no mortal bloodline could. Few possess the knowledge — or the audacity — to attempt it.

rulesStrings.li: subject->god metal alloys
subject_story->alloyed a god metal and lived, which was not the expected outcome
subject_story->worked out the ratios from three surviving pages and a great deal of nerve
subject_story->proved that the divine can be measured, then had to defend saying so
subject_gerund->alloying god metals

ResearchProjectDef.label: glass
ResearchProjectDef.description: A versatile material made from sand and heat. Unlocks glass production and allows construction of fragile but beautiful objects like windows, lenses, and decorative structures.

rulesStrings.li: subject->glassworking
subject_story->learned to read a melt by its colour and never once used a thermometer
subject_story->blew glass for forty years and complained about the sand for all of them
subject_story->made a pane clear enough that a visitor walked into it
subject_gerund->working glass
